proof_scope: ask entrypoints, browser-window reclamation, output pruning, blocker-ledger honesty gates, and the MVP fail-now proof gate, exercised against real browser/filesystem state and a real captured model proposal

claims.proves: the Ask sanity entrypoint and Surf browser-provider preflight recovery classification meet explicit local expectations
claims.does_not_prove: browser provider semantic correctness, live WebGPT review completion, or full Ask orchestration readiness

cases.name: help-does-not-contradict-dispatch
cases.proves: Every handler shortcut --help advertises really routes to tau-dag (probed behaviorally, not by text match), --help makes no blanket 'removed from /ask' claim about a command it still advertises, and the webgpt shortcut genuinely compiles to a Tau DAG.

cases.name: help-contradiction-is-actually-detected
command:
cd /home/graham/workspace/experiments/agent-skills/skills/ask && cp run.sh /tmp/ask-run-sh.bak && python3 - <<'EOF'
s=open('run.sh').read()
s=s.replace("  Use './run.sh webgpt <question>'", "  WebGPT has been removed from /ask. Use $surf webgpt.submit\n  Use './run.sh webgpt <question>'")
open('run.sh','w').write(s)
EOF
uv run python scripts/check_help_dispatch_consistency.py --skip-compile; rc=$?; cp /tmp/ask-run-sh.bak run.sh; rm -f /tmp/ask-run-sh.bak; test $rc -eq 1
cases.proves: The gate is not vacuous: reintroducing the real 2026-08-13 contradiction ('WebGPT has been removed from /ask' beside the advertised webgpt shortcut) makes it FAIL, and run.sh is restored afterward.

cases.name: a-non-selected-tab-is-hidden-so-seats-need-own-windows
command: cd ../../surf && OUT=$(./run.sh window.new 'https://example.com' --unfocused 2>&1) && W=$(echo "$OUT" | grep -oE 'Window [0-9]+' | head -1 | awk '{print $2}') && T1=$(echo "$OUT" | grep -oE 'tab [0-9]+' | head -1 | awk '{print $2}') && T2=$(./run.sh tab.new 'https://example.org' --background --window-id "$W" 2>&1 | grep -oE 'tab [0-9]+' | awk '{print $2}') && A=$(./run.sh js --tab-id "$T1" --no-activate 'document.hidden' 2>&1 | tail -1) && B=$(./run.sh js --tab-id "$T2" --no-activate 'document.hidden' 2>&1 | tail -1) && ./run.sh window.close "$W" >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "selected=$A second=$B"; case "$A$B" in *false*true*) echo SECOND_TAB_IS_HIDDEN;; esac

cases.name: unsupported-flags-never-reach-a-provider-submit
command:
cd .. && uv run --project . python -c "import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'src');sys.path.insert(0,'scripts');import tau_roundtable_worker as w
bad=[]
for sub in ('claude.submit','kimi.submit','gemini.submit','grok.submit','deepseek.submit'):
 c,drop=w._strip_unsupported_flags(['/s/run.sh',sub,'--stable-stall-ms','0','--timeout','60'])
 if '--stable-stall-ms' in c: bad.append(sub)
keep,_=w._strip_unsupported_flags(['/s/run.sh','webgpt.submit','--stable-stall-ms','0'])
assert not bad, bad
assert '--stable-stall-ms' in keep, 'stripped it from the one command that accepts it'
print('FLAG_GATED_CORRECTLY')"
